title: Evaluation of the zero-dimensional learner
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number with $\neg(0<n)$, and let $f$ be any Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The hypothesis returned by running the zero-dimensional exact sparse-spectrum learner with oracle $f$, when evaluated on the cube, agrees with $f$ at every input.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
